Module com.example.cab302project
Package com.example.cab302project.Rewards

Class RewardsService

java.lang.Object
com.example.cab302project.Rewards.RewardsService
public final class RewardsService extends Object
One call for the rewards pane: give it a user and a date range, get back the summary. Ties together the three pieces: read the minutes per day, classify each day against the goals, count the result. The controller should not know that chain exists. Goals are passed in for now. Once the garden_goal lookup is written they will be read per day from there and callers will not have to change.
